title: I built a free version of my AI/quant market analysis project — looking for testers and honest feedback
author: Rare_Reference3909
selftext:
A few days ago I posted here about the architecture behind Nexyria Trader and got some genuinely useful technical feedback from this community.

This time I’d like to test a different part of the project.

I’ve built a free public version of Nexyria that lets users explore market analysis and some of the tools around the project without connecting an exchange or putting capital at risk.

The goal at this stage isn’t to sell trading signals or promise returns. I’m trying to understand whether the tools and information are actually useful to someone discovering the project for the first time.

I’m looking for a small group of people willing to try it and give honest feedback on things like:

• Is it immediately clear what the platform does?
• Which features are actually useful?
• What feels unnecessary or confusing?
• What would make you come back and use it again?

Nexyria currently has three development areas — Trader, Sport and Intelligence — although the market/trading side is the most relevant one for this community.

If anyone wants to test the free version, I can leave the link in the comments.

Critical feedback is absolutely welcome.
